objective: Show the title the AI cover will use and keep cover previews in their real shape.
deliverable: Reviewable pull request with passing tests; no merge or deployment.
requirements: Change src/app/dashboard/ai-cover-generator.tsx, src/app/dashboard/draft-review.tsx and src/app/globals.css exactly as specified in the acceptance test header. All three files are shown.

ai-cover-generator.tsx: add title: string to Props; render a small line before the status message such as: Uses the saved title: {title.trim() || "(no title)"}. Edit and save the title first if needed; each style gets one image per item. Give the preview Image width={1024} and height={saved.style === "ebook" ? 1536 : 1024}.
draft-review.tsx: pass title={savedTitle} to AiCoverGenerator (one small edit).

globals.css: append one line overriding .cover-frame (aspect-ratio:auto; min-height:8rem; max-height:28rem), .cover-frame img (width:100%; height:auto; max-height:28rem; object-fit:contain), and adding .ai-cover-preview (display:grid; gap:.5rem; justify-items:start) and .ai-cover-preview img (display:block; width:auto; max-width:100%; height:auto; max-height:28rem; object-fit:contain; border-radius:.5rem). Do not rewrite existing rules.
No server, API, budget or prompt changes. Use small anchored edits.
acceptance_tests_note: Factory-owned tests run unchanged in the sandbox after the repository checks, together with the existing ai-cover acceptance tests; the builder cannot edit them and must make them pass.
source_manifest_note: Computed by the coding assistant from a separate read-only clone with both the Factory reader and the owner's standalone script (123 files); the Factory fetch verifies it independently before use.
